title: Thinking Fair and Slow: On the Efficacy of Structured Prompts for Debiasing Language Models
findings: The study found that structured prompting techniques, particularly Implication Prompting, were effective in reducing stereotypical bias across various attributes, including religion. The main finding is that providing reasoning to the model about why an output is biased (Implication Prompting) has a positive impact on fair text generation in religious and other contexts. While specific results for religion are detailed in tables, the overall conclusion is that more complex, reasoning-based prompts significantly outperform simpler prefix prompts.
